items.q: Do you handle both residential and commercial HVAC in Allen?
items.a: Yes — single-family homes, multi-story houses in Star Creek, and commercial buildings along the US-75 corridor all get full service.

items.q: Is emergency AC service available at night in Allen?
items.a: Yes, day or night. Our emergency HVAC service runs 24/7 throughout Allen.

items.q: Do you offer indoor air quality services in Allen, like filtration or humidity control?
items.a: Yes. Beyond repair and installation, we offer indoor air quality add-ons like enhanced filtration and humidity control, which matter a lot given how humid North Texas summers get.

items.q: Are HVAC contractors required to be licensed and insured in Allen?
items.a: Yes — Texas law requires HVAC contractors to hold a state ACR license through the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation, along with liability insurance. Air Zone Experts meets both requirements, and owner Adrian Racovei also holds NATE and EPA Section 608 certifications.

items.q: Since when has your company served Allen?
items.a: Family-owned and veteran-owned since we started in 2008 — through Allen’s growth into one of the most desirable suburbs in North Texas.

items.q: What makes Air Zone Experts the right choice for Allen homeowners?
items.a: Referrals drive 85% of our business — neighbors recommending us to other neighbors, backed by 400+ five-star reviews and pricing you can trust.

items.q: What happens when an Air Zone Experts technician arrives in Allen?
items.a: A NATE-certified technician arrives on schedule, inspects the full system, explains what’s going on, and gets your approval on price before any repair.

items.q: What are the signs my AC is about to fail?
items.a: Warm air, weak airflow, strange noises, short cycling, rising energy bills, or a system over 15 years old. In Allen’s summer heat, catching these early prevents a total breakdown at the worst time.

items.q: Will my HVAC repair be finished in one visit in Allen?
items.a: In most cases, yes — one visit is enough, usually within a few hours. If a specific part needs to be ordered, we’ll let you know upfront and get it resolved as fast as possible.

items.q: Do you service homes and businesses along Allen's US-75 corridor and near Allen Premium Outlets?
items.a: Yes. We cover the full US-75 corridor through Allen, from retail and office spaces near Allen Premium Outlets to the residential neighborhoods on both sides of the highway.

items.q: What specific neighborhoods do you serve in Allen?
items.a: All Allen neighborhoods — Twin Creeks, Star Creek, Cottonwood Creek, the Watters Creek area and beyond — plus nearby McKinney, Plano, Fairview, and Lucas.

items.q: What HVAC equipment brands are recommended for Allen?
items.a: Trane is where our authorized-dealer expertise lives, but we install and service all major brands, sized correctly for the North Texas climate.
